title: ADLS storage authorization failure
symptoms: 403 forbidden authorization denied permission ACL managed identity storage access
checks: Identify the managed identity used by the linked service, then check its scoped storage data permissions.
For hierarchical namespace paths, inspect directory traversal and file access ACLs as well as RBAC.
Check storage firewall and private endpoint routing before changing permissions; do not grant broad Owner access.

title: SQL query timeout
symptoms: sql database query timeout timed slow blocking execution connection
checks: Inspect the full inner SQL error to distinguish authentication, syntax and timeout failures.
For timeout symptoms, inspect query plans, blocking and source workload before increasing activity timeouts.
Test a bounded query and compare throughput; use suitable indexes and partitioning when supported.

title: Copy activity schema or column mismatch
symptoms: schema column mapping missing changed csv data type conversion incompatible
checks: Compare the current source schema with explicit Copy activity mappings and the sink schema.
Check delimiter, headers and sampled data types before regenerating mappings.
Test representative rows in a separate destination before applying schema changes to production.

title: Self-hosted integration runtime offline
symptoms: self hosted integration runtime offline node disconnected heartbeat gateway unavailable
checks: Check self-hosted integration runtime node health and whether the host and service are running.
Inspect outbound connectivity, proxy and firewall settings required by the runtime.
Review node logs and resource pressure; validate recovery with a small pipeline run.

title: Transient service throttling
symptoms: 429 throttling too many requests rate limit retry backoff concurrency
checks: Confirm that the error is transient throttling and inspect any Retry-After indication.
Reduce concurrency and use bounded retries with increasing delay; do not retry indefinitely.
Verify idempotency before retrying writes and escalate sustained quota or capacity constraints.

title: Duplicate records after pipeline replay
symptoms: duplicate repeated rows replay retry incremental watermark upsert merge primary key
checks: Compare business keys and source update versions to distinguish legitimate corrections from duplicate delivery.
Use a unique business key and a transactional merge or upsert; record successful ingestion only with the committed load.
Replay a sample batch and verify unchanged row counts and totals before enabling retries.
kind: Portfolio-authored runbook; source link for verification

title: Linked service authentication or secret expiry
symptoms: authentication expired credential secret password login failed key vault linked service token
checks: Determine which credential the linked service uses and inspect its expiry without logging its value.
Check Key Vault access and the configured secret version; validate identity permissions separately.
Rotate expired credentials through the normal secret-management process, then test the linked service connection.

title: Azure Function invocation failure
symptoms: function activity http 500 invocation exception crash response json execution
checks: Check Function execution traces for the same run and correlation identifiers.
Validate request and response contracts, including the response expected by the ADF Azure Function activity.
Check function authentication, app configuration and dependencies; do not paste keys into troubleshooting logs.
